steps.title: Snapshot inventory & configuration
steps.success_criteria: Inventory and config captured for rg-dra-workload and listed resources

steps.title: Verify SQL failover group replication is healthy (dra-fog-e23x)
steps.success_criteria: dra-fog-e23x shows primary in Region A and replication CATCH_UP

steps.title: Start ASR test failover of the reports VM into isolated Region B network (background)
steps.success_criteria: ASR test failover job started for dra-vm-reports into Southeast Asia test network

steps.title: DB team confirms go for forced failover
steps.success_criteria: DB team approval recorded (console/Slack) to proceed with forced failover

steps.title: Start heartbeat writer (1s) for RPO measurement
Inject outage: stop Region A web app (dra-app-eas-e23x)
steps.success_criteria: Region A /health fails (dra-app-eas-e23x stopped) and t0 recorded

steps.title: Forced SQL failover to Region B (paymentsdb via dra-fog-e23x)
steps.success_criteria: Region B (dra-sql-sea-e23x) becomes SQL primary; t_failover recorded

steps.title: Disable Region A Traffic Manager endpoint (dra-tm-e23x)
steps.success_criteria: Traffic Manager endpoint A disabled (traffic directed to endpoint-b)

steps.title: Wait until Traffic Manager serves users from Region B
steps.success_criteria: dra-tm-e23x /health OK confirming Region B is serving users

steps.title: Functional check: submit a payment via Traffic Manager
steps.success_criteria: Payment accepted via dra-tm-e23x and read back from paymentsdb on Region B

steps.title: Measure RPO from heartbeat vs new primary
steps.success_criteria: RPO computed and compared to target (<=15 minutes desired)

steps.title: App team approves failback to Region A
steps.success_criteria: App team confirms readiness to bring Region A back (console/Slack)

steps.title: Start Region A web app (dra-app-eas-e23x)
Wait for Region A to be healthy directly
Planned SQL failover back to Region A (make A primary)
steps.success_criteria: Region A (dra-sql-eas-e23x) is SQL primary again

steps.title: Re-enable Region A Traffic Manager endpoint
Wait until users are served from Region A again via Traffic Manager
steps.success_criteria: dra-tm-e23x /health OK confirming Region A is serving users

steps.title: Verify recovered reports VM serves from Region B and produces daily payments report (ASR test verify)
steps.success_criteria: Recovered VM in Southeast Asia answers /health and produces daily payments report

steps.title: Clean up the ASR test failover (remove test VM)
steps.success_criteria: ASR test VM removed and resources cleaned

steps.title: Stop heartbeat writer
Generate exercise report and notify stakeholders
steps.success_criteria: Exercise report published for Contoso Payments and stakeholders notified

assumptions: Region A = East Asia (primary) and Region B = Southeast Asia (warm standby).
SQL FOG dra-fog-e23x is configured across dra-sql-eas-e23x (A) and dra-sql-sea-e23x (B).
Outage is simulated by stopping dra-app-eas-e23x; production network remains unaffected.
ASR test failover uses dra-vm-reports and runs non-disruptively in an isolated Southeast Asia test network.

steps.success_criteria: dra-fog-e23x shows primary=A (East Asia) and secondaries CATCH_UP

steps.title: Start ASR test failover of the reports VM (isolated network) in background
steps.success_criteria: ASR test failover job for dra-vm-reports started into Southeast Asia test network

steps.title: DB team confirms go for forced failover
steps.success_criteria: DB team records approval to proceed with forced failover to Region B

steps.title: Start heartbeat writer (1s) for RPO measurement
steps.success_criteria: Heartbeat process writing 1s ticks to paymentsdb confirmed

steps.title: Inject outage: stop Region A web app (dra-app-eas-e23x)
steps.success_criteria: Region A /health becomes unavailable (simulated outage of dra-app-eas-e23x)

steps.title: Forced SQL failover to Region B (make Southeast Asia primary)
steps.success_criteria: dra-fog-e23x shows Region B (Southeast Asia) as SQL primary

steps.title: Disable Region A Traffic Manager endpoint
Wait until Traffic Manager serves users from Region B
steps.success_criteria: TM /health reports Region B and application /health OK from Southeast Asia

steps.title: Functional payment check via Traffic Manager (post-failover)
steps.success_criteria: Payment POST accepted and read back from paymentsdb on Region B primary

steps.title: Measure RPO using heartbeat vs new primary
steps.success_criteria: RPO computed and within acceptable test limits (documented)

steps.title: App team approves failback to Region A
steps.success_criteria: App team confirms Region A is ready and approves planned failback

steps.title: Start Region A web app (dra-app-eas-e23x)
steps.success_criteria: dra-app-eas-e23x service started in East Asia

steps.title: Wait for Region A application health (direct)
Planned SQL failover back to Region A (make East Asia primary)
steps.success_criteria: dra-fog-e23x shows Region A as SQL primary with no data loss

steps.title: Re-enable Region A Traffic Manager endpoint
steps.success_criteria: Traffic Manager endpoint A enabled and ready

steps.title: Wait until Traffic Manager serves users from Region A again
steps.success_criteria: TM /health OK from East Asia and users routed to dra-app-eas-e23x

steps.title: Verify the recovered reports VM serves from Region B and produces the daily payments report (ASR test failover verification)
steps.success_criteria: Recovered VM in Southeast Asia responds and produces daily payments report

steps.success_criteria: ASR test VM removed and resources cleaned

steps.title: Stop heartbeat writer
steps.success_criteria: Heartbeat stopped and final timestamps recorded

steps.title: Functional payment check after failback (Payments team requested second check)
steps.success_criteria: Second payment POST accepted and read back from paymentsdb on Region A primary

steps.title: Generate exercise report & notify stakeholders
steps.success_criteria: Exercise report published to stakeholders (includes RPO, RTO, ASR results)

assumptions: Region A = East Asia (primary), Region B = Southeast Asia (DR warm-standby).
Traffic Manager endpoint A points to dra-app-eas-e23x, endpoint B to dra-app-sea-e23x; FQDN dra-tm-e23x.trafficmanager.net used for functional checks.
SQL Failover Group dra-fog-e23x covers paymentsdb with primary initially in Region A.
ASR test failover is non-disruptive and runs in an isolated test network in Southeast Asia.
Heartbeat writer measures RPO against the active SQL primary; paymentsdb is used for functional transactions.
